A stále spieva aj o láske tak, ako by mu išlo o život. A ja som mu to včera totálne verila všetko. Inak celá organizácia v Stadthalle bola špičková, kapela mala dokonalý zvuk a bonbónikom boli mobily zamknuté v puzdrách Yondr, takže máte hyper fokus len na to, čo sa deje na pódiu, na to, čo s vami robí tá hudba. Powered entirely by clockwork, it moved across the banquet table while its internal mechanism produced music, eventually coming to a stop before a guest, who was then expected to drink from the detachable goat’s head-shaped vessel.
